name: Sampler — Load Your Own
description: Pitched one-shot .wav player triggered by a step sequencer. Auto-loads a bundled CC-BY ride cymbal; load your own from the picker or the file button.

params.text:
SAMPLER — LOAD YOUR OWN

A pitched one-shot .wav player. This preset AUTO-LOADS a bundled CC-BY ride cymbal (s-tek, freesound) so it plays on open.

USE
- Bundled picker: swap to the crash (or your own) from the dropdown at the top of the Sampler.
- 'Load .wav': pick any local file (drum hit, vocal, stab). It is decoded, mono-mixed and resampled to the engine rate. The waveform is drawn below the buttons.
- 'Preview' auditions the loaded file locally without the engine.

Signal: Step Sequencer (gate) -> Sampler -> Output

TIPS
- All step pitches are 0, so the sample plays untransposed. The sequencer's CV is patched to the Sampler's Pitch input (V/oct, +12 = one octave up) — edit the step pitches to play a MELODY.
- Switch to Loop mode for sustained textures; the Loop Start / End knobs set the loop region (shown on the waveform).
- Short Release = tight, long Release = a ringing tail.

LICENSE: bundled samples are CC BY 4.0 (see public/samples/CREDITS.md). Commercial packs (e.g. AudioRealism 909) are usable locally but NOT redistributable — don't commit them.
